lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rain. Cold stone. I was in the supply room a moment ago.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: One more count before dawn. That's what I kept telling myself.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: No hands. No boots. I seem to have kept the exhaustion.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a lamp beyond the ditch. Please let someone be holding it.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Easy. The last thing that crawled out of that ditch tried to eat my boots.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I'll try to be a better guest. I'm Rainoray. Quartermaster.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Rainoray? Your supplies reached us. You never did.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I'm having some trouble accounting for myself. Where is everyone?

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: We sent the wounded east. Then the rift struck the gatehouse. The Warden turned on the road it was guarding.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: And you stayed?

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Someone has to be here if they come back. I'm Mara.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Follow the torn banners east to Muster Ground. The road runs on through Inner Court to the gate.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Someone called from the storehouse south of that road. You might fit under its fence.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The dead still draw back before they strike. Step aside, then answer.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: East past the banners, then north at Inner Court. The signal tower lies north of camp if you need bearings.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: East, then north. I used to mark those supply routes myself.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Rest to steady your Ichor. Leave supplies here or at a lit brazier; we'll gather them.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The gate's quiet. Was that your doing?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rainoray. Quartermaster. I was looking for a way out.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: You're the name on our supply slips? I'm Mara. I kept a bed for you.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: We sent the wounded east before the Warden turned. I tried to follow, but the roots had closed the forest road.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Then that's where I'll look next.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Come back if you find them. Come back if you don't, too.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A dispatch, folded under the bell rope. 'Hold the east road until the last stretcher passes.'

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: No death count. Just names marked missing. Mine is here, too.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Someone crossed it out, then wrote it back in. Mara should see this.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Someone crossed it out, then wrote it back in. Someone wasn't sure.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Every bed was stripped for bandages. Except this one.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A note on the blanket: 'For whoever comes back.'

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a dry dressing underneath. I'll leave it where she can find it.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: My seal. These are the crates I stayed to count.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: 'Blankets on top. Leave the weapons if the cart is too heavy.' My handwriting, too.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The blankets are gone. Good. At least that part worked.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I found the evacuation list. You crossed out my name.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: I thought I'd seen you fall. Then I thought of how far away I was.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: So you wrote it back in.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Yes. I'm glad I did.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: HALT. THE LAST STRETCHER HAS NOT PASSED.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: They're gone. Mara's the only one left. Open the gate.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's no stretcher on this road. Let me through. Someone may still need help.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: People are still coming back. You're blocking their way. Open the gate.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: ICHOR DETECTED. YOU ARE NOT ON THE EVACUATION LIST.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rainoray. Quartermaster. You watched me bring those supplies in.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: QUARTERMASTER: DECEASED. HOLD THE ROAD.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Then you'll have to stop me twice.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The chain is broken. Stretcher tracks run through the gate and into the trees.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Only one set of footprints comes back. Mara's.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Only one set of footprints comes back toward camp.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The others got this far. I can follow them.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The gate's quiet.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: It's open. I'm going after the stretcher tracks.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: I tried. The roots have swallowed the road. There's a dry scarf by the fire; take it before you go.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I'm not sure it would stay on.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Then I'll keep it dry.

lines.speaker: TOBIN
lines.text: Who's there? If you're a rift thing, I'm mostly bandages. Poor eating.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rainoray. Quartermaster. Mostly water, these days.

lines.speaker: TOBIN
lines.text: The quartermaster? We carried your crates out and left your name on the list.

lines.speaker: TOBIN
lines.text: The fence came down behind me. I couldn't climb it, and nothing friendly fits under.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Mara's lamp is still lit at Captain Camp. Can you make it that far?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a lamp by the captain's tent. Head there. Someone is keeping it lit.

lines.speaker: TOBIN
lines.text: For a lamp? I'll crawl. Thank you.

lines.speaker: ILSE
lines.text: Stay back. I've got one good arm and I'm not afraid to use it.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rainoray. Quartermaster. I cut the thorns, not you.

lines.speaker: ILSE
lines.text: Ilse. Signals. I hid in here when the brambles came up. They grew faster than I could cut.

lines.speaker: ILSE
lines.text: That chest is the quartermaster's cache. Locked tight, and the key went with the storehouse.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Then it's still my job. Go to Mara's lamp at Captain Camp.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a lamp by the captain's tent. Head there. Someone is keeping it lit.

lines.speaker: ILSE
lines.text: If anyone can find one small key in this mess, it's the man who counted every nail.

lines.speaker: VENN
lines.text: Took them long enough to send someone. I pictured someone taller.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Nobody sent me. I'm afraid I'm just late.

lines.speaker: VENN
lines.text: Venn. Sergeant, once. I told the stretcher crew to go on without me.

lines.speaker: VENN
lines.text: Then the culvert silted up and I spent a week talking to the rain.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Mara is keeping a fire at Captain Camp. She has room for you.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a lamp by the captain's tent. Head there. Someone is keeping it lit.

lines.speaker: VENN
lines.text: Mara. Good. Then I'll go and be shouted at properly.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The cache opens. Bandages, a little coin, and my ledger.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Every crate, every blanket, every name that signed for them.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Tobin, Ilse, Venn. All signed the same morning. I'll see that the count comes out right.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Someone walked into my camp tonight and asked for you by name.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: They were still out there, waiting. I couldn't leave them.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Then keep looking. The dispatch listed more people than the Warden let through.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Tobin, Ilse and Venn. Three beds that aren't empty anymore.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The count finally adds up. Better than I'd hoped.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Ilse found the last of the good tea. Take the coin we were saving with it. You've earned both.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Keep to the road. I'll keep the lamp lit.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: One name off the missing list. Keep looking.
lines.revision_reason: User reassigned post-rescue line to Sage

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Watch its windup. Then move.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I only need one opening.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: More power. Less control.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Good. I'll use that.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Fall back. You need room.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The road's open.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: And you are still here.
